scope: Blackflow Tree Sea node behavior and deterministic rewards used to constrain simulator rules

sources.name: PRTS Blackflow Tree Sea main page

verified_constraints.rule: Three choices are shown from a six-choice pool: max HP +3, squad limit +1, hope +3, advanced supply voucher +1, action points +2, parts-box capacity +1.
Choose one of two collectibles for free; four ingots may refresh the pair once, after which only one collectible is still chosen.
Gain one processed item and convert remaining action points to hope at 1:1; stored recruitment vouchers may be used.
Carry remaining action points to the next floor and gain one valuable or rare processed item; stored recruitment vouchers cannot be used.
Doors are paired; action points are consumed on entry only. They do not appear on floors I, II, or VI.
The spawn reveals itself and four adjacent nodes; visiting expands reveal to the surrounding twelve nodes and grants one action point.
Up to three promoted operators may be hired. Refresh starts at four ingots, rises by four each time, and is limited to four refreshes. The node is absent on floors I and VI.

policy: Unknown probabilities remain synthetic or NEEDS_OBSERVATION and must not be promoted to evidence-backed status.
